title: Regions Financial Corp. to Acquire The Frazer Lanier Company, Expanding Municipal and Corporate Investment Banking Services
summary: Acquisition strengthens Regions’ capital markets capabilities, expands municipal finance experience, and will enhance services for public and institutional clients across the United States. Regions Financial Corp. on Thursday announced it has closed on the acquisition of The Frazer Lanier Company, Incorporated , a full-service investment banking firm specializing in municipal and corporate securities. Regions Financial Corp. headquarters in Birmingham, Ala. Based in Montgomery, Ala., Frazer Lanier serves corporations, cities, counties and local boards, building a reputation for excellence in corporate and municipal finance since the company’s founding in 1976. Thousands of clients have turned to Frazer Lanier to serve as an underwriter or placement agent for tax-exempt and taxable bonds.
